Results.ReviewText: We wanted to jump into the gas grill world- been using a small weber grill for 20 years... This came incredibly well packed, and we used the book and also the video to assemble it. Took some time but wasn't that tricky. Liek that it's fairly compact, but large enough to do several items at once. And is very sturdy. Have grilled veggies, chicken and a couple pizzas on it so far. Getting to know the tricks and how things cook will take a bit of practice but it's worked great!  (Pizza stone heated over direct heat for a few minutes than shoved over to indirect- slide the pizza onto the stone and in about 10-15 minutes you should be good!)
Results.Title: Gas Grill Newbies

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your grill is not getting hot enough. Your grill should easily reach 500-550F and if it is taking a very long time, something is not right. We are here to help!

Here are some tips for getting your grill to high heat:

1.) Please make sure you consider "High" on your control knobs to be the first spot to your left (the 9:00 position). The further you go to the right the lower the temperature will be and all the way to the right is low.

2.) Please make sure you're always cooking with the lid down except when flipping the food halfway. The second you open the lid the heat escapes, and you'll need to close it to let the temperature recover.

3.) It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset, but how you want to light your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position (including side burner if applicable)
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the first burner to start/high
Hit your igniter
Turn on all remaining burners
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 500-550°F

If troubleshooting doesn't resolve the issue, please respond to the email that our Support team sent you so we can assist you further. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: So far I am very happy with this purchase,  The reason I gave it a 4 star rating is because I am still learning how to use it and haven't quite mastered it yet.  I realize that is my problem not the grills, so once I use it more I'll update my review.  I assembled the grill by myself and had no problems although there were a couple of times an extra hand would have helped.. The instructions were very easy to understand and it went together well. Seems like a sturdy grill and is easy to move around.  One of the things I like best about it is the email support you get from Weber on grilling techniques, recipes etc. It's a nice feature and I've learned from it. I can't wait to try some of the more advanced cooking techniques I've read  about.  Definitely worth the money.
Results.Title: Nice grill

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
